dashboard.summaryZh: 管理数据集、结构化表格和可复用的数据输入。
dashboard.summaryEn: Manage datasets, structured tables, and reusable data inputs.
handoffZh: 结构化数据集可作为工作流输入。
支持空间格式的数据集版本可进入地图与叠加层流程。
handoffEn: Structured datasets can feed workflows as inputs.
Spatial-ready dataset versions can enter map and overlay flows.

dashboard.summaryZh: 查看产品资料、三维预览与可公开展示的产品资产。
dashboard.summaryEn: Browse product records, 3D previews, and publishable showcase assets.
handoffZh: 公开产品可作为对外展示资产复用。
产品文件与元数据统一回到资产中心管理。
handoffEn: Published products remain reusable as showcase assets.
Product files and metadata stay managed in the asset hub.

dashboard.summaryZh: 可视化地图叠加层、ROI 与空间分析结果。
dashboard.summaryEn: Visualize map overlays, ROIs, and spatial analysis outputs.
handoffZh: 符合 overlay 输入结构的工作流输出可在地图中打开。
保存的 ROI 可作为工作流空间输入。
handoffEn: Workflow outputs that match the overlay structure can open on the map.
Saved ROIs can feed workflows as spatial inputs.

dashboard.summaryZh: 编排数据处理、模型推理与结果产出链路。
dashboard.summaryEn: Compose data preparation, model inference, and result delivery chains.
handoffZh: 数据集、ROI、模型和个人凭证可作为工作流输入。
符合条件的工作流输出可回到地图或资产中心。
handoffEn: Datasets, ROIs, models, and personal credentials can feed workflows.
Qualified workflow outputs can hand off to maps or the asset hub.

dashboard.summaryZh: 管理模型版本、训练产物和外部 API 模型配置。
dashboard.summaryEn: Inspect model versions, training artifacts, and external API model configs.
handoffZh: 模型版本可用于工作流推理节点。
训练输出可沉淀为可复用的模型资产。
handoffEn: Model versions can feed workflow inference nodes.
Training outputs can become reusable model assets.

dashboard.summaryZh: 管理个人资料、安全设置与账号申请。
dashboard.summaryEn: Manage profile, security settings, and access requests.
handoffZh: 账号资料与可复用资产分开管理。
角色申请与安全设置会更新账户状态与可见权限。
handoffEn: Account information stays separated from reusable assets.
Access requests and security changes update account state and permissions.

dashboard.summaryZh: 管理可复用输入、流程结果、共享能力与发布状态。
dashboard.summaryEn: Manage reusable inputs, workflow outputs, shared capabilities, and publication state.
handoffZh: 资产中心展示每项资产的下一步流转入口。
工作流、地图和模型产出的资产，以及 GEE 凭证这类共享能力，统一汇集到这里。
handoffEn: The asset hub shows where each asset can go next.
Assets produced by workflows, maps, and models, plus shared capabilities such as GEE credentials, collect here.

dashboard.summaryZh: 处理账号审批、角色变更与操作记录。
dashboard.summaryEn: Review account approvals, role changes, and workspace actions.
handoffZh: 审批结果会影响总览页可见模块与入口状态。
审批操作完成后会更新总览状态。
handoffEn: Approval outcomes update visible modules and entry points on the overview.
Approval actions also update overview state.

dashboard.summaryZh: 维护总览公告、平台邮件和工作空间级配置。
dashboard.summaryEn: Maintain overview announcements, platform email, and workspace-level settings.
handoffZh: 公告内容同步到总览页，便于查看最近更新。
系统级配置与账号页、资产页分开管理。
handoffEn: System settings stay separated from account and asset pages.
